body: Fintech Ramp reached a $60 billion valuation, and AI cloud company Modal raised a $750 million Series D at $15.75 billion after its revenue run rate passed $1 billion.
India's Scimplify raised $25 million for specialty chemicals and critical materials, led by Hitachi Ventures.
Across the 30 days to 18 October, startups announced 601 rounds worth $31.9 billion, with 38 AI rounds in the last week alone.
dek: 601 rounds and $31.9B raised in 30 days, with AI taking the biggest share.
title: Startup funding week: Ramp hits $60B, Modal raises $750M
